name: Prunes / dried plums
description: Dried plums, stewed into desi qormas and eaten for digestion.

unani.note: Aloo bukhara is a classic Unani cooler.

nutrition.highlight: eaten for what they do, not what they taste like

effects.note: An 8-week randomised crossover trial found prunes beat psyllium — the standard fibre-supplement comparator — on both bowel movements per week and stool consistency, at a matched fibre dose. One of the better head-to-head showings of any food on this list, which is why prunes are the first thing reached for, not a folk runner-up. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.

A 12-month randomised controlled trial in 235 postmenopausal women found that eating 50g of prunes a day — about ten — preserved hip bone mineral density where a no-prune control group lost it, an effect that held from six months through to twelve. Researchers point to the fruit's polyphenol content acting on bone-remodelling and inflammation pathways, a separate mechanism from the laxative effect above. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
